skill_name: Identify five reasons why going to school is important
workflow: Going to school is important for numerous reasons.  First, education gives students the tools needed to pursue their dreams. Schools teach necessary skills such as problem solving, critical thinking, and creativity, which can help students achieve their goals. Schools also provide an opportunity to network and develop social skills, which can be critical to success later in life.
